item.title: GL.iNet cloud compromise hits routers and KVMs, older backdoors also found
item.description: Attackers compromised GoodCloud, GL.iNet’s cloud remote management service, and used it to install malware on routers and KVM (keyboard, video and mouse) devices connected to it. The Chinese company, best known for its small travel routers, is still investigating, and it’s not yet known how many devices have been affected. item.title: AlertZero in Elastic Security: Every alert answered. Every decision yours
item.description: Agents triage alerts, hunt threats, tune noisy rules and reconstruct what happened on a host. Each hands you a proposed action with the evidence behind it, and you set how far it goes alone and which model it uses.

item.title: Press play on Elastic Security 9.6, banger after banger
item.description: AlertZero works your alert queue in the background and nothing consequential it proposes runs until you approve it. 9.6 also brings entity resolution, MITRE ATLAS mappings, 143 AI detection rules, and Linux ransomware protection.
